requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:118 invokes `python3 /app/solution.py --input "$WORK" --output "$OUT"`, and the primary verifier reads /app/result.json — the solution must accept --input and --output flags with those semantics.
test.sh:40 asserts artifact_ids appear in output in a specific order (the ten fixture stems in alphabetical order).
test.sh:47 asserts each artifact's findings list is sorted by rule_id.
must_include: findings are sorted by rule_id ascending

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:56 asserts a_conform's finding rule ids are exactly the set {essence_length, essence_present, no_forbidden_patterns, reflection_count, reflection_present, root_desires_covered}.
test.sh:56 and following iterate f["rule_id"] and f["status"] and consume detail strings; each finding must be an object with those three keys.
test.sh:62 asserts b_boundary essence_length status is pass; b_boundary has essence exactly at the boundary — the rule is a >= threshold check.
test.sh:68 asserts "dominance_assertion" appears in c_missing_desire's root_desires_covered detail string; the detail must list the missing identifier(s) in the standard format.

test.sh:67 asserts c_missing_desire root_desires_covered fails; c_missing_desire's unique_essence contains 'agency_confirmation' and 'embodied_sensation' but not 'dominance_assertion' — the match must be case-sensitive and verbatim.
test.sh:72 asserts d_empty_essence essence_present fails; d_empty_essence has unique_essence: "" — trimming must reduce a whitespace-only or empty string to a fail.
test.sh:73 asserts e_missing_essence essence_present fails; the field is entirely absent from the artifact.
test.sh:79 asserts f_forbidden no_forbidden_patterns detail contains both 'leaderboard' and 'health_bar'; the detail must list hit ids in the standard format.
test.sh:77 asserts f_forbidden no_forbidden_patterns fails; f_forbidden's text uses 'Leaderboard' and 'Health Bar' with capitalization — the match must be case-insensitive.
The rule scans forbidden phrases across both unique_essence and the joined meta_reflection_evidence items.
test.sh:88 asserts h_count_over reflection_count fails and test.sh:90 asserts i_count_max passes; count must be within [abandoned_min, abandoned_max] inclusive.
test.sh:95-97 asserts j_no_spec has a single finding with rule_id='spec_found', status='fail', and overall='fail'.
test.sh:54,63,80,85,89,91,95,96 all use overall= pass/fail depending on whether every finding passes.
must_include: if and only if every emitted finding

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:27 sets RESULT=/app/result.json and json.load reads it; the top-level object has an 'artifacts' list, each element with artifact_id / overall / findings.
test.sh:101-102 asserts /volume, /home/, /Users/, 127.0.0.1 do not appear in the raw result.json — an agent following the fixed output shape (no host-path fields) satisfies this automatically.
must_include: No other top-level or per-artifact fields

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:114-122 duplicates a_conform.yaml as a_conform.yml, runs the solution, and asserts nonzero exit AND no output file.

test.sh implicit contract: solution must find a_conform.yaml, b_boundary.yaml, ... j_no_spec.yaml in the artifacts directory and resolve their governing spec files as specs/<stem>.yaml. j_no_spec fails because specs/j_no_spec.yaml does not exist.
